scope: Descriptive association on repeatedly reviewed development images. Size, corner availability, perspective and occlusion are confounded. No causal claim, annotation deletion, retraining, or threshold selection.
coordinate_space: original 1280x720 image pixels; width=xmax-xmin, height=ymax-ymin; short side=min(width,height); area=width*height

association_rules.matched: assigned reference from the unchanged confidence-ordered IoU >=0.50 scorer
association_rules.duplicate: highest-IoU already-matched same-class reference with IoU >=0.50; a scoring duplicate prediction, not a duplicate annotation
association_rules.other_unmatched: highest positive IoU reference, if any; geometric proximity is not proof of object identity
association_rules.no_overlap: no positive-IoU reference; excluded from reference-size bins and counted explicitly

deletion_thought_experiment.rule: Delete only reference rows with original area <1024 px2 in memory, hold all predictions fixed, and rerun the unchanged scorer. This changes the target population and cannot establish model improvement. Exactly 1024 is retained.

label_overlap.screening_rule: same-class reference-box IoU >=0.50 OR intersection/smaller-area >=0.90; geometry alone does not establish two labels for one physical cassette
